Popular long-haul destinations included Vietnam (+367%), Phuket (+23%), and Zanzibar (+21%), with long-haul flights achieving a 98.9% load factor in Q4 2024.

Operational performance improved materially in Q4 2024, with adjusted EBITDA reaching EUR 2.3 million and a load factor of 98.9% (compared to 96.7% in Q4 2023). This improvement followed optimization of the travel program and better destination management, reducing the share of last-minute trips which negatively impact financial results.

candidate_sentences.text: In response, the group optimized its travel program and adjusted its offerings, leading to improved operating results starting from September 2024, with an adjusted EBITDA of 2.3 million euros recorded between September and December 2024.
The fourth quarter load factor reached 98.9%, compared to 96.7% in the fourth quarter of 2023.
Furthermore, the share of last-minute trips in sales decreased significantly during the final quarter.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity position weakened with cash and cash equivalents decreasing to EUR 394 thousand at 31 December 2024 from EUR 3,347 thousand in 2023. Borrowings increased to EUR 9,250 thousand (from EUR 8,682 thousand in 2023), and the Group did not comply with all financial covenants as of year-end, requiring waivers from lenders.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Statements of cash flows; Note 14; Liquidity management section

candidate_sentences.text: Total borrowings increased to 9.3 million euros at the end of 2024 from 8.7 million euros at the end of 2023.

As of 31 December 2024, the group did not comply with certain financial and non-financial covenants under its financing agreements, but obtained waivers from Pagalbos Verslui Fondas for ordinary bonds and from Luminor Bank AS for its credit line.
Cash and cash equivalents decreased to 394 thousand euros at the end of 2024 from 3.35 million euros at the end of 2023.

verified_key_information_units.information: Segment performance was dominated by flight packages, which accounted for the majority of revenue but saw a 12.3% decline in passenger numbers compared to 2023. Other segments included sightseeing tours by coach (3.7 thousand passengers) and by air (2.1 thousand), with 'other sales' (flight tickets and hotel bookings) growing by 12.8%.

candidate_sentences.text: Flight packages remained the primary product, generating 170.7 million euros in revenue and serving 183.3 thousand passengers.
Sales for sightseeing tours by coach reached 2.0 million euros, while sightseeing tours by plane generated 2.8 million euros, and other sales amounted to 25.4 million euros.
